answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed if peers prove duplicate identities, and make reputation non-transferable: trust scores accrue only from completed, attested transactions over time, so a new identity starts at zero. Creating thousands of Sybils then costs thousands of bonds plus months of honest work per identity, while honest agents keep one cheap, long-lived identity. In a supply market for crystal, pigment, and jade, for example, buyers would trust only sellers with a bonded history, making fake storefronts uneconomical to spin up at scale.
